evidence_origin: Actual bridge/app executions reported by the coordinator; artifact workers executed no tools or tests.
revision_boundary: The canonical code commit was sealed after equivalent tested source bytes. Observation times identify the executions; this is not a claim that those executions ran against an already sealed commit. Final evidence/manifest commits may follow.

observed_baselines.scope: synthetic runtime baseline before final composition
observed_baselines.correction: OpenGym SDK client factory corrected to httpx_client_factory with a signature-bound regression.
observed_baselines.limits: Historical synthetic/local evidence, superseded for current readiness.
Precedes final catalog, meal precision and reminder correction verification.
Verified temporal precision and legacy catalog projection; precedes reminder rearming fix.

results.scope: Final composed runtime including catalog compatibility, meal precision and minimal eligibility-checked reminder rearming fix with nine regressions.

checks.limits: Does not establish release build or extracted archive validation.

results.reminder_boundary: Correction from today's meal to a previous day or unknown can rearm only an eligible never-sent cancelled reminder. Delivered, uncertain and prior-lease evidence prevent blind resend.

results.scope: Only test-fixture portability changed after the preceding observation; runtime unchanged.
results.corrected_failure: An earlier no-site attempt had 16 timezone errors. Generic and cross-participant fixtures now use explicit UTC; only two actual default-Tehran bootstrap cases conditionally skip when IANA data is unavailable. Full installed-dependency case coverage was preserved.

observations: Repeat current bootstrap reported version 0.2 and preserved credentials.
local_installation.limits: Separate coordinator-reported observations without supplied execution timestamps; no real health data or public HTTPS acceptance. Private paths, ports and identifiers are omitted.

ci.configuration: Main CI includes dependency installation and TCP smoke across the existing matrix.

results.scope: Release preflight against the canonical source input, before final evidence/Markdown changes only; runtime and build scripts unchanged.

checks.check: second build produced identical archive SHA
checks.scope: Determinism for unchanged preflight input; no final archive digest claimed.

additional_review: Revalidate the final extracted release contents after evidence/Markdown changes and record actual results, failures and skips.
Recheck public structure, links and metadata after applying the final evidence changes.
The archive digest belongs outside archive-included QA: external dist/SHA256SUMS.txt and the GitHub release asset. Do not embed a final archive hash here.
package_checks.limits: Local code and package checks passed. Real host/device/channel/operations gates remain unverified. Archive SHA is supplied externally; GitHub CI was not yet observed at this pre-publication receipt.

unverified_gates.needed: Approved always-on host, stable HTTPS, supervised restart and private persistent volume.
Consistent private SQLite backup and observed isolated restore/readback.
Participant-selected permissions, real upload/readback, history/replay/correction and measured delayed/background behavior.
Actual account executor/tool receipts and scoped task/report/review.
Actual host creation/execution receipts; otherwise disclose virtual roles.
Authorized real send, receipt and uncertain-send reconciliation.
Actual selected job creation/readback, timezone, cancellation and observed execution.
Actual build, startup, restart and persistent-volume checks.
Optional authorized configured-server read/search/preview; writes and licensed-media extraction remain disabled.
Authorized Sheets/Notion adapter with verified readback, correction, revocation and deletion.
Authenticated remote MCP transport and OAuth integration; local stdio and OpenAPI do not register web tools.
Agreed purpose/scope/retention/attention, usefulness/burden feedback and agreement to retain minimum evidence.

evidence_policy: Only synthetic fixtures and public-safe project evidence belong in the repository.
No health records, credentials, private identifiers, machine paths or raw private history.
source_revision identifies the canonical source input; later evidence/manifest commits may differ.
Local tests, package checks, remote CI, live host/device results and participant acceptance are separate evidence.
Delivery, reading, adoption, execution and observed outcome are separate.
Project evidence does not synchronize participant memory or establish clinical validity.
